abilities.name: Feast of Bloodshed
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: For each enemy unit that was destroyed this turn, pick a friendly Ogor Mawtribes unit that is not in combat and has not used the 'Power Through' command this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Each target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Smash and Grab
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly Ogor Mawtribes unit that charged this turn and for which the unmodified charge roll was 8+ to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Each target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with the units it was in combat with at the start of the move.

abilities.name: Prowling Predators
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly Ogor Mawtribes units while they are wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and have not charged this turn.

abilities.name: Grub's Up, Mateys!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly Ogor Mawtribes unit that has been picked to be a target of the 'Eat 'Em Alive' ability this battle to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Heal (D3) each target.

abilities.name: Fixated on Feeding
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Ogor Infantry unit that is not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can move a number of inches equal to the roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. If it ended that move in combat, the target has charged.

abilities.name: Postprandial Warfare
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick up to D3 friendly Ogor Infantry units that were in combat this turn with an enemy unit that was destroyed this turn to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Return 1 slain model to each target unit.

abilities.name: Eat 'Em Alive
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Ogor unit that used a Fight ability that targeted a unit, excluding Faction Terrain, this turn to use this ability. Then, you can pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. The same enemy unit cannot be picked to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target (if any). Then, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to that friendly Ogor unit for the rest of the battle. If any of these effects already apply to it, you can pick a different effect to replace the current effect. • *Raw and Bloody Flesh*: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that unit. • *Exotic Giblets*: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by that unit's combat attacks made with non-Companion weapons. • *Steaming Brains*: Add 2 to that unit's Control characteristic. • *Crunchy Bones*: That unit's melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits). If that unit's melee weapons already have Crit (2 Hits), they have Crit (Mortal) instead. • *Slick Innards*: That unit can use Charge abilities even if it used a Run ability in the same turn. • *Mystery Meat*: Subtract 1 from the power level of enemy units while they are in combat with that unit, to a minimum of 0. *Designer's Note: Only 1 of these effects can apply to the same unit at the same time unless specified otherwise. Also note that Steaming Brains affects the Control characteristic, not the control score.*

abilities.name: Bull Charge
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Ogor Mawtribes unit that charged this turn and has not used a Rampage ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Your opponent must move the target up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of your units and can end that move in combat. After your opponent has done so, roll a dice for each model in the unit using this ability that is within 3" of the target. Add 1 to the roll if the unit using this ability is a Gutbusters unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, the unit using this ability can make a pile-in move. If the target of this ability is still in combat with the unit using this ability, then the target of this ability must be picked as the target of the pile-in move. *Designer's Note: Your opponent may not be able to move the models in the target unit (or may choose to leave them where they are) but the target still counts as having moved for rules purposes.*

abilities.name: Jaws of the Beast
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Beastclaw Hero that is leading a regiment and that has not been deployed, then pick a non-Hero unit in that Hero's regiment that has not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve tracking the prey. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: Closing the Jaws
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Beastclaw Hero that is tracking the prey.
abilities.effect: Set up that Hero wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up the other friendly unit that is tracking the prey wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge, wholly within 9" of that Hero and more than 9" from all enemy units.

powers.name: Blood Feast
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Ogor Mawtribes Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly Ogor Mawtribes unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
powers.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's combat attacks.

powers.name: Shincruncher
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Ogor Mawtribes Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
powers.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target ends a move or is set up on the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target after the ability has been resolved. *Designer's Note: The 'Bull Charge' ability in the battle traits forces an enemy unit to move.*

powers.name: Tallowflage
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Ogor Mawtribes Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly Ogor Mawtribes unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
powers.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target is not visible to enemy units more than 12" away from it.

powers.name: Freezing Tailwinds
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Ogor Mawtribes Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Ogor Mawtribes unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
powers.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target. Add 2 instead if the chanting roll was 6+.

powers.name: Pulverising Hailstorm
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Ogor Mawtribes Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
powers.effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Then, inflict 3 mortal damage on the target(s).

powers.name: Fortifying Hoarfrost
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Ogor Mawtribes Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Ogor Mawtribes unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
powers.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that friendly unit.

abilities.name: Scything Blade
abilities.timing: Any Movement Phase
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic in one direction (see 'The Pendulum Swings'). It can pass through models during that move and can end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this Manifestation passed across during that move or that are within 1/2" of it to be the targets. Roll a D6 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: The Pendulum Swings
abilities.effect: This Manifestation cannot use Charge or Fight abilities. In addition, when this Manifestation moves, it must move in a straight line either in the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing or in the opposite direction to the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing

summon.name: Summon Aethervoid Pendulum
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Aethervoid Pendulumon the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up an Aethervoid Pendulum wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Mechanisms of Time
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: If there are any friendly Wizards within 3" of this Manifestation, pick 1 of the following effects: *Increase Time Flow*: Until the start of your next turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation. *Decrease Time Flow*: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly Wizards while they are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Chronomantic Cogs
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Chronomantic Cogs endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Chronomantic Cogs endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Dancing Blades
abilities.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted by this Manifestation's attacks.

summon.name: Summon Quicksilver Swords
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Quicksilver Swords endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Quicksilver Swords endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Harbinger of Horror
abilities.timing: Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by this Manifestation's shooting attacks this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is less than the number of models in the target unit that were slain this phase, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

summon.name: Summon Horrorghast
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Horrorghast endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Horrorghast endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Traverse the Tides of Death
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Infantry Wizard Hero within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield within 3" of this Manifestation and not in combat. Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

summon.name: Summon Lauchon the Soulseeker
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Lauchon the Soulseeker endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Lauchon the Soulseeker endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Phantasmal Translocation
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Pick a part of this Manifestation, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 9" of the other part and more than 3" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Ensnaring Soul-drain
abilities.effect: Each time an enemy unit uses a Move ability while it is within 9" of any parts of this Manifestation, the effects of the 'Fly' ability do not apply to that unit. Enemy units cannot be set up within 9" of either part of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Shards of Valagharr
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Shards of Valagharr endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Shards of Valagharr endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Shards of Valagharr endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Deathly Passage
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 6" of one part of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the other part of this Manifestation and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

summon.name: Summon Soulscream Bridge
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulscream Bridge endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Soulscream Bridge wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulscream Bridge has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Devourer of Magics
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: If this Manifestation destroyed any enemy Manifestations this turn, Heal (6) this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Arcane Predator
abilities.effect: You can add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this Manifestation, to a maximum of 3, while it is within 18" of any enemy Manifestations, but if you do so, it must end the charge move within 1/2" of an enemy Manifestation.

abilities.name: Wild Form
abilities.effect: Each time this Manifestation is targeted by the 'Banish Manifestation' ability, if it would be banished, it is not banished. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

summon.name: Summon Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Morbid Detonation
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: You must, and can only, use this ability if this unit has 6 maelstrom points. Pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 9" of it to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this Manifestation is destroyed.

abilities.name: Necrotic Vortex
abilities.effect: Give this Manifestation 1 maelstrom point each time: • This Manifestation is set up. • A unit successfully casts a spell while it is within 12" of this Manifestation. • A model is slain within 12" of this Manifestation. This Manifestation can have a maximum of 6 maelstrom points at once.

summon.name: Summon Malevolent Maelstrom
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly a Malevolent Maelstrom endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a a Malevolent Maelstrom endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: End Given Form
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this Manifestation passed across during that move to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Pull of the Nadir
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for friendly and enemy units while they are within 3" of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Purple Sun of Shyish
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Purple Sun of Shyish endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Purple Sun of Shyish endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Bound for the Great Oubliette
abilities.timing: Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: For each part of this Manifestation, you can pick an enemy unit within 3" of that part to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+: • Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. • Subtract a number of inches equal to the roll from the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.

summon.name: Summon Soulsnare Shackles
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulsnare Shackles endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Soulsnare Shackles endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulsnare Shackles endless spell has 3 parts that must each be set up within 3" of at least 1 other part.

abilities.name: Pulled to the Grave
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, you can pick an enemy unit that this Manifestation passed across during that move to be the target. Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

summon.name: Summon Suffocating Gravetide
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Suffocating Gravetide endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Suffocating Gravetide endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Tendrils of Light and Shadow
abilities.effect: Enemy units cannot use commands while they are within 3" of either part of this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play. Each time this Manifestation moves, both its parts must end within 9" of each other. Each part of this Manifestation is armed with Tendrils of Light and Shadow.

summon.name: Summon Geminids of Uhl-Gysh
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizardto cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Blinding Light
abilities.effect: This Manifestation cannot be targeted by shooting attacks. In addition, a unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks if it is impossible to draw a straight line from a model in the attacking unit to a model in the target unit without that line passing across this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Prismatic Palisade
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Prismatic Palisade endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Prismatic Palisade wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Arcane Passage
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Wizard within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: The next time the target uses a non-Summon Spell ability this phase, add 1 to the casting value of that spell. When picking targets for that spell, you can measure range and visibility from either part of this Manifestation instead of from the caster, and your opponent can measure range and visibility to either part of this Manifestation instead of to the caster for the purposes of the 'Unbind' ability.

summon.name: Summon Umbral Spellportal
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Umbral Spellportal endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up an Umbral Spellportal wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. An Umbral Spellportal has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Restored Vigour
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Heal (3) this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Bounteous Healing
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: Heal (3) the target.

summon.name: Summon Emerald Lifeswarm
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Emerald Lifeswarm endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Emerald Lifeswarm endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Ravening Hunger
abilities.timing: Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this Manifestation charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 10 dice. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

summon.name: Summon Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

weapons.name: Burning Breath
weapons.ability: Shoot in Combat, Anti-WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend)

abilities.name: Burning Up
abilities.effect: Each time this Manifestation uses a Shoot ability, after that ability has been resolved, allocate 1 damage point to this Manifestation (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point).

abilities.name: Trophy Rack
abilities.timing: Deployment Phase
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following trophies. For the rest of the battle, melee weapons used by other friendly Ogor Mawtribes units have the corresponding weapon ability while they are wholly within 6" of and visible to this unit: • *Squeezed Head*: Anti-Monster (+1 Rend) • *Smashed City Rubble*: Anti-War Machine (+1 Rend) • *Torn Appendages*: Anti-Cavalry (+1 Rend)

abilities.name: Carvalox Hide
abilities.effect: This unit has Ward (6+). It also has Ward (4+) against damage points inflicted by Spell abilities, Prayer abilities and abilities used by Manifestations.

abilities.name: Mantle of Entrails
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a command, roll a dice as a reaction. On a 3+, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

abilities.name: Leave Not a Morsel
abilities.effect: While they are within 6" of and visible to this unit, enemy units cannot be healed or have slain models returned to them.

abilities.name: Dreaded Far and Wide
abilities.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to: • This unit's control score. • Hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit's non-Companion attacks. • Charge rolls for this unit. • The number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit.

abilities.name: The Crusherguts
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is automatically slain and the target cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Extremely Obstinate
abilities.effect: This unit has a Control characteristic of 15.

abilities.name: Horn Toss
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that has no more than 1 model, that is in combat with this unit and that has charged this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of this unit. Then, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Grumpy Alpha
abilities.timing: Enemy Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick another visible friendly Ogor Monster wholly within 12" of this unit that is not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, roll a dice. The target can move a distance in inches up to the roll. It can end that move in combat. If it does so, the target has charged.

abilities.name: Battlebroth
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: If this Great Mawpot is full, Heal (D3) each visible friendly unit wholly within 18" of it. After you have done so, this Great Mawpot is empty.

abilities.name: Vessel of the Gulping God
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If this Great Mawpot is full, pick a visible friendly Ogor Mawtribes Wizard wholly within 3" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Throw 'Em In
abilities.effect: This Great Mawpot is either full or empty. It starts the battle full. If an enemy model is slain within 12" of this Great Mawpot while it is empty, it becomes full.

abilities.name: Hungry Sinkhole
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick this Mawpit to be a sinkhole. Then, you can pick another terrain feature within 12" of this Mawpit and that you have not already picked to be a sinkhole this battle to be a sinkhole for the rest of the turn. Then, pick every enemy unit within 3" of the sinkhole(s) to be targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. From the second battle round onwards, increase the range at which another terrain feature can be picked to be a sinkhole by 3" each battle round. If this terrain feature has a Head Butcher, increase the range at which another terrain feature can be picked to be a sinkhole by 6" that turn instead of 3". This effect is cumulative.

abilities.name: Feed the Maw
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If this terrain feature does not have a Head Butcher, pick a friendly Butcher within 3" of it and not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now a Head Butcher (see 'Hungry Sinkhole').

abilities.name: Step Away from the Maw
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: If this terrain feature has a Head Butcher that was not placed on it this turn, set up the Head Butcher on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a Head Butcher.

abilities.name: Biggest-Game Hunter
abilities.effect: The Damage characteristic of this unit's Skullshatter Crossbow and Impaling Spear is 4 if the target is a Monster.

abilities.name: The First Shot's Mine!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's shooting attacks to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by friendly Beastclaw units that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Trogg-Guts
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Ogor Mawtribes unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has Ward (6+) until the start of your next turn. If you picked a Mawseekers unit, it has Ward (5+) until the start of your next turn instead.

abilities.name: More Meat for the Pot...
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit this turn by this unit's combat attacks or by combat attacks made by a Manifestation summoned by this unit, and that enemy unit has been destroyed, add 1 to this unit's power level for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Torrent of Flame
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's Fire Breath if the target is Infantry.

abilities.name: Stone Skeleton
abilities.effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Stonehorn's Rock-hard Horns and Hooves is 4.

abilities.name: Earth-Shattering Charge
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn and has not used the 'Bull Charge' ability this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target and then roll 2D6. This unit can move a distance in inches up to the value of the roll. It can pass through models in the target unit but must end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Enraged Roar
abilities.effect: While this unit is damaged, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of Companion weapons used by other friendly Ogor Mawtribes units while they are within this unit's combat range.

abilities.effect: If this unit charged in the previous turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

abilities.name: Lumbering Titan
abilities.effect: This unit cannot use Run or Retreat abilities.

abilities.name: Terrible Table Manners
abilities.effect: While this unit is in combat, friendly units within this unit's combat range cannot use the 'All-out Attack' or 'All-out Defence' commands.

abilities.name: Empty Belly Curse
abilities.effect: This unit cannot be healed.

abilities.name: Self-Preserver
abilities.effect: This unit has Strike-last while it is in combat with an enemy Monster.

abilities.name: Overbearing Bulk
abilities.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Stone-hard Skeleton
abilities.effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

abilities.name: Extremely Ornery
abilities.timing: Enemy Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: If any visible friendly units had any damage points allocated to them this turn, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if any damage points were allocated to this unit this phase. On a 4+, this unit can move up to 2D6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Force of Nature
abilities.timing: Any Charge Phase
abilities.effect: This unit has Fly for the rest of the phase. Each time this unit ends a move this phase, inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy non-Monster unit it passed over.

options.name: Chaintrap, Harpoon Launcher or Blood Vulture

weapons.name: Chaintrap, Harpoon Launcher or Blood Vulture

abilities.name: Loves a Good Fight
abilities.effect: While this unit is in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn, this unit has charged this turn.

abilities.name: Jocular Disposition
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to D3 visible friendly non-Monster Ogor units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Return 1 slain model to each target.

abilities.name: Holy Ogor
abilities.effect: Add 1 to chanting rolls, chanting rolls and banishment rolls for this unit.
